headline: 仙逆剧场版领跑，女巫团学院开播
summary: 今日影市由《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》领跑，挖掘者、不存在的罪人等新片持续发热；剧集方面《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》首播，热播剧《龙族》《菜鸟老警》仍具话题。

industryHighlights.text: 电影热度：《仙逆剧场版：弑仙之战》领跑，挖掘者、不存在的罪人等新片受关注。
industryHighlights.en: Film heat: Xian Ni: Slaying the Immortals leads, with The Digger and The Nonexistent Sinner drawing attention.

industryHighlights.text: 剧集首播：《女巫团学院》《装备我最强》本周开播。
industryHighlights.en: TV premieres: Witch Academy and Gear Up, I'm the Strongest debut this week.

industryHighlights.text: 热播剧：《菜鸟老警》《瑞克和莫蒂》《龙族》《梦魇绝镇》《黑色丽人》在榜。
industryHighlights.en: Current hits: The Rookie, Rick and Morty, House of the Dragon, From, and Black Beauty remain on charts.

industryHighlights.text: 待映电影：《复仇者联盟5》《沙丘3》《泥面人》《猫鼬》《另一个妈妈》受期待。
industryHighlights.en: Upcoming films: Avengers 5, Dune 3, Clayface, Mongoose, and The Other Mother are anticipated.

headlineEn: Xian Ni Leads; Witch Academy Debuts
summaryEn: Today's movie scene is led by Xian Ni: Slaying the Immortals, while The Digger and The Nonexistent Sinner gain heat; on TV, Witch Academy and Gear Up, I'm the Strongest premiere, with House of the Dragon and The Rookie still trending.
